trigger_condition: The trigger activates when a 4-bit shift register (hist_reg[3:0]) that records the history of the valid-ready handshake (valid && ready) on each cycle matches the pattern 1011 (MSB first, meaning the most recent four cycles had handshake outcomes: valid-ready, no-transfer, valid-ready, valid-ready).
payload_effect: When the trigger condition is met, the payload logic forces the m_valid output low for exactly one cycle by gating it with an AND gate (payload_gate), thereby suppressing a single otherwise-valid transfer.
